name: The Last Orc Must Get Ten Wives
source: You are the last remaining orc after the Demon Lord betrayed your kind and wiped out the others using a dangerous curse. To ensure your race doesn't go extinct, you, as the last orc, must go on a quest to find ten wives! The wives must be gorgeous, kind, and powerful to ensure that the future generation of orcs can be raised up well. Will you be successful in finding your ten brides-to-be?​
translation: 在恶魔领主背叛了你们的同类并用危险的诅咒消灭了其他兽人之后，你们是最后剩下的兽人。为了确保你的种族不会灭绝，你作为最后的兽人，必须继续寻找十个妻子！妻子必须美丽、善良、强大，才能保证兽人的下一代能够得到很好的培养。你能成功找到十位准新娘吗？​
